notes.title: A Heart of Butterblue -- Now Released!
notes.notes:
My newest game, A Heart of Butterblue is now released on steam! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406550?beta=0]A Heart of Butterblue[/url]

It's a FREE horror vn/lite farm sim where you farm and forage all while trying to find out what happened to your missing grandfather. 

Check it out!

notes.title: Heart is Muscle 1.32 - New Battle System
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

I've just uploaded a brand new build for Heart is Muscle 1.32. 
This version includes:

1. Brand new battle system for the random encounters
2. New soundtrack
3. New talking SFX
4. Overworld Health reminders
5. More monsters to fight on overworld map

The rest of the game is the same. 
Thank you so much for playing!

notes.title: Heart is Muscle at NextFest!
notes.notes:
Come watch me play through my game, Heart is Muscle! 

The event will be a pre-recorded video divided into two parts. 

The first part, I'll introduce the game and show all the different things you can do while also giving some insider developer commentary. 

Then finally for the second part I'll draw a brand new picture of Borislav and Mirche while chilling to some nice relaxing music. 

Looking forward to it!
